name: columnar_vocab_host_mac_group
query: FROM logs-system.syslog-* | STATS c=count(*) BY host.mac | SORT c DESC | LIMIT 20

name: columnar_vocab_redis_args_group
query: FROM logs-redis.slowlog-* | STATS c=count(*) BY redis.slowlog.args | SORT c DESC | LIMIT 20

name: columnar_vocab_validate
label: {{ columnar_vocab_label | default('unnamed') }}
q1-query: FROM logs-* | STATS count=count(*) BY agent.version, agent.type, agent.hostname | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 20
